_doc: Default sys_sequence rows shipped by metadata-starter. Apps copy this file (or its merged form) into their seed manifest as a tenant file: a tenant gets it when it is set up, and a seed sync adds the rows a release adds to tenants set up before. Each row's `id` is its preId tracking key (sys_pre_data) — keep it equal to `code` to make matching trivial.
_warning: Loading this file whole (SysPreDataService.loadPreTenantData) has create-or-update semantics: a row the tenant already has would be OVERWRITTEN, admin edits included. That is why it runs only while a tenant is being set up; a set-up tenant only ever receives rows it does not have.
_never_seed_the_counter: Do NOT add `currentValue` / `lastResetKey` to a row below. They are runtime state, and create-or-update would rewind a live counter on every re-apply — the sequence then re-issues numbers already in use and the business insert dies on a duplicate key. A fresh row's NULL lastResetKey makes the first allocation take startValue, so leaving the counter out is also the correct first-time behaviour.
_convention: code must match `<ModelName>.<fieldName>` for SequenceProcessor auto-fill to activate. Other names are valid but will not trigger automatic field population.
